title: 第25章 意外之喜第26章 秦诗瑶的怀疑
lines: “那一座破塔有什么好稀奇的，还不如这一个炼丹炉呢！”
楚峰瞥了一眼破塔，心中鄙夷道。
在他看来，这破塔根本就没啥用。
“小子，就凭你那眼光，好东西放在你眼前，你都发现不了。
你可还记得，那九个光团的顺序？那破塔在何处？”
楚峰细想了一下。
碎片，残图，破塔，宝剑，丹炉，手串，巨斧，玉瓶，宝刀。
破塔排在第三位。
“哼，能够排在第三位，你说它没用？
如果不是因为残破的缘故，它恐怕还在那残图之前。”
葫灵并未说碎片。
开玩笑，自己本体碎片，当然得排在第一位。
“如果本灵猜得没错，完整的破塔，应该是一件王器！”
王器！
楚峰心中震动不已。
那可是王者才会拥有的法宝啊！
“只是，我要怎么才能进去呢？”
楚峰沉思道。
这一切看似很长，实则不过几个呼吸的时间而已。
“苏长老，真是误会，误会啊！
小武师侄因为痛失亲人，心情有些欠佳，所以冒犯了诸位，还请见谅！”
另外一位云天宗的长老再次打圆场。
苏紫英冷哼一声，炼丹炉一直悬在头顶上空。
双方陷入了对峙。
“师傅，对不起！”
夏侯武此刻也终于是冷静了下来。
“苏长老，这一次的确是我们不对，不过，为了那件宝物，老夫还有一个不情之请！”
“吴老鬼，你不要得寸进尺！”
苏紫英将自己的炼丹炉激发。
虽然她还没有炼化，但是基本的掌控却可以做到。
“苏长老，还请老夫说完！”
吴老鬼连忙说道。
“老夫侥幸得到这一座宝塔，洞悉了它的一些基本功能。”
苏紫英等人开始聆听了起来。
谁都想知道对方的所获宝物的功能。
未免以后遇见之时，能相互之间有所准备。
所以，不仅是苏紫英，其他几位长老，都没有出言阻止。
相互妥协，无非就是利益交换罢了。
“这宝塔名为炼魂塔，虽然老夫未曾将其炼化，但是却可以催动它。
只要修为弱于元海境的武者，老夫便可以利用此塔，让其说真话，而且不会对他们的灵魂造成伤害。
所以，老夫建议，这里的所有人都进入此塔，一一检验他们所说的是否为真。
诸位也可以和老夫一起，共同见证！”
吴老鬼根本就没有任何隐瞒，当众说了出来。
content_en:
"What's so strange about that broken tower? It's not as good as this alchemy furnace!"
Chu Feng glanced at the Broken Tower and said with disdain in his heart.
In his opinion, this broken tower is of no use at all.
“Boy, with your eyesight, you can’t even spot the good things right in front of you.
Do you still remember the order of the nine light groups? Where is the broken tower? "
Chu Feng thought about it carefully.
Fragments, broken pictures, broken towers, swords, alchemy furnaces, bracelets, giant axes, jade bottles, and swords.
Broken Tower came in third.
“Hmph, it’s ranked third, but you’re saying it’s useless?
If it weren't for the dilapidation, it would probably still be there before the incomplete picture. "
Hu Ling did not say fragments.
Just kidding, of course the fragments of my own body must be ranked first.
"If my guess is correct, the complete broken tower should be a royal weapon!"
A royal weapon!
Chu Feng was shocked in his heart.
That is a magic weapon that only a king possesses!
"It's just, how do I get in?"
Chu Feng said thoughtfully.
All this seems very long, but in fact it only lasts a few breaths.
"Elder Su, what a misunderstanding, misunderstanding!
Nephew Xiaowu is in a bad mood because of the tragic loss of his family, so I offend you all, please forgive me! "
Another elder of Yuntian Sect once again smoothed things over.
"Hmph!"
Su Ziying snorted coldly, the alchemy furnace kept hanging above her head.
The two sides fell into a confrontation.
"Master, I'm sorry!"
Xia Houwu finally calmed down at this moment.
"Elder Su, it is indeed our fault this time, but for that treasure, I have one more unmerciful request!"
"Old Ghost Wu, don't push yourself too far!"
Su Ziying activated her alchemy furnace.
Although she has not yet refined it, she can achieve basic control.
"Elder Su, please finish my words!"
Wu Laogui said quickly.
"I was lucky enough to get this pagoda and understand some of its basic functions."
Su Ziying and others began to listen.
Everyone wants to know the function of the other's treasure.
I hope we can be prepared for each other when we meet in the future.
Therefore, not only Su Ziying, but also several other elders did not say anything to stop him.
Mutual compromise is nothing more than an exchange of interests.
"This pagoda is called the Soul Refining Tower. Although I have not refined it, I can activate it.
As long as their cultivation is weaker than that of Yuan Hai realm warriors, I can use this tower to make them tell the truth without causing harm to their souls.
Therefore, I suggest that everyone here enter this tower and test one by one whether what they say is true.
You can also join me and witness together! "
Wu Laogui didn't hide anything at all and said it in public.
